page_title: ACM 1-2 CRE | AC Milan v Cremonese 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+5' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Giuseppe Collu with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90+4' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

90+4' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
90+4' The referee signals a corner kick to AC Milan.

90+3' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+3' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
90+1' Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Half-chance! Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) plays a pass into the box, but Emil Audero reacts well to snuff out the attack.
89' The free kick is taken by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan), but ball is cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
88' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) is the one who receives a yellow card.
86' Dangerous play by Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan). Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul. Cremonese win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
86' Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
85' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Cremonese earn a free kick.
84' It is time for a substitution. Manuel De Luca (Cremonese) is on for Federico Bonazzoli.
83' Davide Nicola has decided to substitute Matteo Bianchetti and he is replaced by Federico Ceccherini (Cremonese).
83' Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Cremonese, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
81' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
78' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) attempts to discuss the decision with Giuseppe Collu, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.

78' The game is interrupted. Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Cremonese get a free kick.
77' Giuseppe Collu shows a yellow card to Martin Payero (Cremonese), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
75' A corner kick by AC Milan is thwarted by the well prepared Emil Audero (Cremonese).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) replaces Luka Modric.
69' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
69' Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul after Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Cremonese, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
65' A substitution has been made. David Okereke goes off and Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) comes on.
65' Here is a change. Fikayo Tomori is going off and Massimiliano Allegri gives the last tactical orders to Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).

64' What a miss! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
63' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
61' 1 - 2 GOOOOOAL! Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) finds space in the box from the lofted pass and lands the perfect scissor-kick goal. G.O.A.T? Probably not, but it’s 1:2.
60' Luka Modric (AC Milan) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
56' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Alberto Grassi is replaced by Warren Bondo (Cremonese).
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jari Vandeputte trots off the pitch and is replaced by Martin Payero (Cremonese).

56' That's a well-taken pass by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
55' AC Milan fail to score from a corner as Emil Audero (Cremonese) leaps to collect the ball.
54' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) makes a weak connection with the corner kick, and his close-range header is easily blocked. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
54' Luka Modric (AC Milan) will take the corner.

54' A pass into the box finds Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Emil Audero denies him. The ball goes out for a corner. AC Milan can continue in their attacking effort.

53' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) wins himself some space to meet the corner kick and unleashes a low shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
53' Luka Modric (AC Milan) prepares to take a corner kick.

52' Luka Modric (AC Milan) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Emil Audero has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
52' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.

51' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.

49' Ambitious effort from Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
48' Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) sees a yellow card from Giuseppe Collu after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

47' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Emil Audero blocks the shot with his legs.
46' Half-time substitution. Pervis Estupinan will not participate anymore and Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) is coming on.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) makes it 1:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Pervis Estupinan and planted his close-range header into the right side of the goal. Emil Audero was helpless.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) misses the left post by a whisker with a close-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
44' Emil Audero leaps to intercept the corner kick from Luka Modric (AC Milan).
44' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Luka Modric (AC Milan) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AC Milan.
43' Luka Modric (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

39' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) was too forceful with his tackle and Giuseppe Collu interrupted the game to signal a free kick. AC Milan are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
39' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
38' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
36' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
33' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
32' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
32' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
31' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.

31' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. AC Milan have been awarded a free kick.
30' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.

28' 0 - 1 Alessio Zerbin produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 0:1.
28' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

26' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Emil Audero makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target.
24' A lofted pass into the box is met by Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
23' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

23' A pass into the box finds Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Mike Maignan denies him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Cremonese.
20' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

17' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.

17' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
16' Luka Modric (AC Milan) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
15' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
11' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
11' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
10' AC Milan keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
7' An attempted cross from Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) is cleared.
6' The corner from Luka Modric (AC Milan) is hurriedly cleared.

4' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Cremonese are ruled offside.
2' Emil Audero is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan). Easy save!
2' Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese). AC Milan have a free kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! AC Milan will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Giuseppe Collu.
